title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle-vendor-kube-distro-support-rke2-flatcar-debian
author: Alice Chen
description:
Motivation: Improve the on-prem/private installer to better support vendor kube distributions in fully air-gapped environments. Customers deploying with RKE2, Flatcar, and Debian-based OS images requested first-class vendoring of distro artifacts (containerd, kernel modules, deb packages) and deterministic offline bundles. This PR updates the offline bundle generator, vendoring scripts, Helm chart defaults, and Terraform modules to add opt-in support for vendor-specific layouts and node labeling so operators can deploy in a variety of on-prem footprints.

This description is a single continuous string and contains the change summary, checklist, commit summary, and review thread.

Summary of changes: 
- offline-bundle-generator: add new vendor profiles (rke2, flatcar, debian) and ability to include apt repos and .deb artifacts in the tarball. Generator now produces a manifest.yaml with artifact digests and preferred install ordering.
- vendoring: add packaging scripts to vendor containerd runtimes, rke2 images, CNI binaries, and Flatcar-specific files into the airgap bundle. Tarballs are signed with project key when available.
- helm/redwood-private: introduce chart values.vendor.distro, vendor.enabled flags, and conservative defaults (imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent, hostNetwork fallback) for air-gapped installs. Add networkPolicy exceptions for node-provisioner job.
- terraform/modules/private-installer: expose node_label and kubelet_extra_args variables, added support for tainting vendor nodes and nodeAffinity for kube-system components.
- docs: update onprem/airgap/README with new vendor profiles, upgrade/rollback steps for vendor bundles, and verification checklist.
- tests: add integration harness test for generator profiles (unit + e2e simulation with local registry).
- CI: add a sanity check to validate manifest.yaml schema and artifact digests before publishing bundles.

Checklist (from PR template): 
- [x] Design review: ENG-6120 discussed and approved vendor approach.
- [x] Unit tests for generator logic added.
- [x] E2E simulation pipeline added to validate bundle install in an isolated cluster.
- [x] Docs updated with vendor profile examples and rollback steps.
- [x] Security review for vendored binaries performed (note: still pending legal signature on upstream Flatcar artifacts).

Commits (high-level): 
- add: offline-bundle generator vendor profiles and manifest feature
- feat: vendor packaging scripts for rke2/flatcar/debian
- chore: helm chart vendor values and defaults
- feat: terraform module node_label/node_affinity support
- test: integration harness for simulating airgap installs
- docs: airgap vendor README + upgrade instructions

Files changed (high level): see changed_files field for main touched paths. No large diffs; most code is new generator logic and packaging helpers.

Review conversation (abridged):
- Ben Liao (reviewer): "Can we add an option to include apt sources.gpg and apt-transport? Also request a short note in docs about verifying apt repo signatures in the airgap flow."
- Alice Chen (author): "Added apt sources and signature checks to the generator; updated docs with verification steps and example apt sources list."
- Ravi Kumar (reviewer): "Terraform changes look good but add acceptance tests for node_label variable so we don't regress older installs."
- Alice Chen: "Added terraform acceptance test and small migration note in docs explaining new variable defaulting to empty to maintain backward compatibility."
- Elena Garcia (approver): "Verified manifest schema and signed tarball workflow in the integration pipeline. Approving pending CI green."

CI summary: initial run: lint + unit tests passed, integration e2e flake on bundle load (timeout). Re-ran the failing job with extended timeout; all checks passed. Added a CI sanity check for manifest digest validation to prevent regressions.

Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals. Merged_at: 2026-03-03.

Notes for release notes:
- Add vendor profiles for RKE2, Flatcar, and Debian to the airgap offline bundle generator.
- Helm chart: new values.vendor.* to opt into vendor packaging behavior.
- Terraform module: optional node_label/node_affinity variables for vendor node targeting.
- Migration: no breaking changes; vendor flags are opt-in.

Related Linear items: ENG-6120 (vendor profiles), ENG-5984 (bundle manifest), SUP-1421 (customer request).
